content.hi:
Steps of Factorization Method
Quadratic equation ax² + bx + c = 0 ko factorize karne ke steps:
• Step 1: Equation ko standard form (ax² + bx + c = 0) mein likho
• Step 2: a × c ka product nikaalo
• Step 3: Do aise numbers dhoondo jinka product = a×c aur sum = b ho
• Step 4: Middle term (bx) ko in do numbers ke terms mein split karo
• Step 5: Common factor nikaal kar equation ko factorize karo
• Step 6: Har factor ko 0 ke equal rakho aur x ki values nikaalo

💡 Tip: a × c = product aur b = sum. Yeh do numbers dhoondhna sabse important step hai!

content.hi:
Factorization Trick
ax² + bx + c = ax² + p x + q x + c,    where p×q = a×c and p+q = b
Middle term bx ko px + qx mein split karte hain jahan p aur q aise numbers hain jinka product a×c aur sum b hota hai.
Example: x² + 5x + 6 mein a×c=6, b=5. Numbers: 2 aur 3 (2×3=6, 2+3=5)
